I was at work today when I felt a rumbling similar to the conception of an earthquake. They asked to apply for a small loan so I asked them for all the usual documents associated. Looking them up and down I noticed that her son was even fatter than her and wondered how he could possibly look after his hippopotamus mother when he himself was the size of the Duff blimp. Anyway, I digress.

They don't hear me because they are literally arguing about which take away to get for dinner.
